title: bianca
description: BIANCA: Brain Intensity AbNormality Classification Algorithm

label_feature_num.description: Column number (in the master file) of the manual masks (or any placeholder name for query subjects)
label_feature_num.title: Label feature number

brain_mask_feature_num.description: Column number (in the master file) of images to derive non-zero mask from
brain_mask_feature_num.title: Brain mask feature number

query_subject_num.description: Row number of query subject (in masterlistfile)
query_subject_num.title: Query subject number

training_nums.description: Subjects to be used in training. List of row numbers (comma separated, no spaces) or 'all' to use all the subjects in the master file
training_nums.title: Training numbers

feature_subset.description: Set of column numbers (comma separated and no spaces) for features/images to use (default: use all available modalities as intensity features). The image used to derive non-zero mask from must be part of the features subset
feature_subset.title: Feature subset

mat_feature_num.description: Column number of matrix files (in masterlistfile). Needed to extract spatial features (MNI coordinates)
mat_feature_num.title: Matrix feature number

spatial_weight.description: Weighting for spatial coordinates (default = 1, i.e., variance-normalized MNI coordinates). Requires --matfeaturenum to be specified
spatial_weight.title: Spatial weight

patch_sizes.description: List of patch sizes for local averaging
patch_sizes.title: Patch sizes

training_pts.description: Number (max) of (lesion) points to use (per training subject) or "equalpoints" to select all lesion points and equal number of non-lesion points
training_pts.title: Training points

non_les_pts.description: Number (max) of non-lesion points to use. If not specified will be set to the same amount of lesion points
non_les_pts.title: Non-lesion points
